name: ClickUp
description: Plan, track, and manage any type of work with project management that flexes to your team's needs.

events.d: Retrieve all lists in a space, including lists inside folders and those without a folder.
List the teams (workspaces) accessible to the connected account.
List spaces in a team. Optionally filter by archived status and return selected fields.
Apply reusable components to workspace, space, folder, and list dropdowns
List folders in a space, optionally filtering by archived status.

Create a task in a list and set title or markdown description, assignees (by ID or email), group assignees, tags, status, priority, start/due dates (with time), time estimate, watchers, custom fields, parent, points…
Get profile details for the authenticated user.
Create a list in a space or folder.
Update an existing task's name, description, status, dates, assignees, tags, and other settings.
Update a list by its id

events.n: When a new task is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically whenever a new task is created.
Runs the workflow automatically whenever any task is updated.

events.n: Add Checklist and Items to a Task
events.d: Add a checklist to a task and optionally create checklist items.
Retrieve a task's details by ID, optionally including subtasks, the Markdown description, selected response fields, or using a custom task ID.
Add a time entry to a task (by start/end or duration) with optional notes, billable flag, tags, assignee, or custom task ID.
Runs when a new or updated comment is posted on a task in a chosen workspace, space, folder, or list.
Archive a ClickUp task or permanently delete it.
Set or update the value of a custom field on a task.
Retrieve custom fields from a workspace, space, folder, or list.
Add a comment to a task. Optionally notify everyone or assign the comment to a user or group.
Retrieve all comments on a task (newest first); supports custom task IDs, pagination start, and selected response fields.
Add a subtask to an existing task.
List replies for a chosen comment, optionally returning selected fields.
